There is no indication of card-not-present misuse, out-of-region travel, card testing, or account-takeover anomalies. The sole M5 mismatch and moderate risk score constitute a weak, isolated signal. Therefore the probability of fraud is assessed at roughly one-third, and the activity is most likely legitimate.
